title: Blood Pressure Care Guidance
source: Indian Guidelines on Hypertension (IGH-IV) & ACC/AHA BP Guidelines
reviewed_by: Dr. R. Mehta, DM (Cardiology Review Board)

exercise: 150 minutes/week of brisk walking or cycling

doctor_tests: Physician or Cardiologist review within 2–4 weeks
Home BP log (morning & evening for 7 days), Serum Creatinine, Urine ACR
exercise: Practice stress reduction and breathing exercises
food: DASH diet: reduce pickles, papads, packaged snacks
Increase leafy greens and low-fat dairy
moderate.hospital_guidance: Outpatient clinic with ECG and basic lab support.

doctor_tests: Urgent Physician / Cardiologist evaluation within 24–72 hours (immediately if >=180/120 mmHg)
ECG, Kidney Function Test, Electrolytes, and Fundoscopy
exercise: Get medical clearance first before starting or intensifying exercise.
Avoid heavy isometric lifting until blood pressure is stabilized.
high.hospital_guidance: Emergency-capable hospital with Cardiac & Internal Medicine support.
